paragraphs: Visit or contact us if you need help with permits for your small business.
Staff from the Office of Small Business are available at the Permit Center. They can help you with permits needed for your small business in San Francisco.
When you're here, we'll ask you about your plans, and get you going on your permitting journey.

Many agencies are here, including the Planning Department, Department of Building Inspection, the Health Department, Fire Department, Entertainment Commission, and Recreation and Parks. This makes it easier and faster to have your questions answered.
Language translation services are available throughout the building, including Spanish, Filipino, and Chinese.
Schedule an appointment with a permitting specialist.
Watch a video to learn more about the Permit Center.

sections.heading: Getting here
paragraphs: Please visit the Help Desk on the second floor of the Permit Center. Drop in or schedule an appointment .

sections.heading: Getting here › Accessibility
paragraphs: The building is completely ADA accessible. There are no steps to the front doors, and elevators are available inside.

paragraphs: We are closed on public holidays. Plan Review and Print Center queues will close at 4:30pm, but payments will be accepted until 5pm.
